title: THE OFFICE
subtitle: skipto.tv
blurb: Nine seasons at Dunder Mifflin Scranton, charted season by season: the Michael Scott years and everything after him, Jim and Pam from the reception desk to Philadelphia, every manager in the big office, and the corporate layers stacked above them — New York, then Sabre, then David Wallace.
regularsNote: Series regulars — Michael, Dwight, Jim, Pam, Ryan, Andy, Angela, Kevin, Oscar, Stanley, Phyllis, Meredith, Creed, Kelly, Toby, Darryl, Erin and the later additions — aren't listed here; use the roster row on the chart for them. This dropdown is TVmaze's guest cast: Jan, Holly, David Wallace, Roy, Karen, Jo Bennett, Todd Packer, Mose and the rest of Scranton's orbit.
chartHint: Nine seasons across. Click any bar to filter the episode list; mid-season changes are drawn at season granularity with the exact episode (TVmaze numbering) in the label.
